module_name: Company Analysis - Past, Present, and Future

quiz.name: 2027 Equities - Module 10 Company Analysis - Past, Present, and Future

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod10-Q1
entry.itemBody: Which of the following strategies is most likely to apply to economies of both scale and scope?

choices.itemBody: C. Differentiation-based focus Feedback A is correct because economies of scale and scope are most applicable under a cost leadership strategy, since each aims to reduce the average cost of supplying goods and services. B is incorrect because it is difficult to achieve economies of scope in a focus strategy. C is incorrect because differentiation focus strategies are unlikely to benefit from economies of scale or scope.

C. either cost leadership or differentiation. Feedback C is correct because a focused strategy may employ either cost leadership or differentiation aimed at a specific group or product. A is incorrect because either cost leadership or differentiation can be the basis for a focus strategy. B is incorrect because either cost leadership or differentiation can be the basis for a focus strategy.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod10-Q3
entry.itemBody: In a declining industry, which of the following factors is most likely to intensify competitive rivalry?

choices.itemBody: C. Research and development Feedback A is correct because declining industries often face excess capacity due to declining demand, a factor that intensifies competitive rivalry among industry participants. B is incorrect as product differentiation may occur at any life-cycle stage and is not necessarily a competitive driver in declining industries. C is incorrect as research and development is more likely to be a factor affecting competitive rivalry among startup or growth companies.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod10-Q4
entry.itemBody: Higher working capital efficiency is most likely to be associated with an increase in:

choices.itemBody: C. days payables outstanding. Feedback C is correct because an increase in a firm’s payables outstanding results in a shorter cash conversion cycle, which is equal to days of sales outstanding plus days of inventory on hand minus days of payables outstanding. A is incorrect as an increase in days sales outstanding will lengthen, not shorten, the cash conversion cycle. B is incorrect as an increase in days inventory on hand will lengthen, not shorten, the cash conversion cycle.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod10-Q5
entry.itemBody: Return on invested capital (ROIC) is best described as a measure of:

choices.itemBody: C. the amount needed for a company to earn excess returns Feedback B is correct because the ROIC measures return to all investors, as it includes both long-term liabilities such as debt and average equity in the calculation. A is incorrect because ROIC measures after-tax return to all investors. C is incorrect because it describes the weighted average cost of capital (WACC), not ROIC

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod10-Q6
entry.itemBody: A firm raises debt to finance a new production facility. Prior to the facility opening, the firm will most likely experience:

choices.itemBody: C. a reduction in net working capital. Feedback B is correct because issuing debt increases the firm’s liabilities and associated interest expenses, thereby increasing financial leverage. A is incorrect because operating margin excludes interest and would not be affected by financing decisions. C is incorrect because raising debt typically affects long-term liabilities, not current assets or liabilities directly associated with net working capital.
